name: Semantic Objective Camouflage
description: Reframes a "minimum spanning subgraph" objective into a "signal convergence" (facility location) narrative. Models relying on surface patterns will interpret "converge at a single node" + "minimum cost" as minimizing the sum of path lengths to a median node. The examples maliciously yield the same result for both interpretations, causing pattern-matching models to confidently submit a Tree Median DP that fails on hidden tests where path overlaps make the two metrics diverge.
